items.information: 🇧🇷 O Capixaba Challenge 2023 é o 15º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CapixabaChallenge2023/register); - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE) do Rafael Cinoto; - Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição; - Divirta-se! ------------------------------------- 🇺🇸 Capixaba Challenge 2023 is the 15th Official Competition of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CapixabaChallenge2023/register) tab; - Arrive at the competition venue 30 minutes before the event in which you will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, the cube may not be accepted for the competition; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists; - If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE) by Rafael Cinoto; - Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition; - Have a lot of fun! ------------------------------------- ### Organização/Organization: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ1k4IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--05c34cfd81e1c48df3d1c4c00f5fa2977da05bc5/logo-speedcubes%20(1).png)

items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to northern Colorado Springs for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! * **Please read the travel tab before registering. Parking instructions are different than previous competitions at this venue!** * **This competition has a 105 competitor limit.** Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! * Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition,[ this video ](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)will provide you with most of the information you need. * If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:15 AM. * **If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team**, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 75 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of Friday, July 7, 6:00 PM MDT. items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło aż 54 turnieje w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted 54 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1pCIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--16c17111f94e16ebabc88aca1be85268f8e979fd/image.png) **Español** En el Campeonato Titan FMC 2023, el objetivo principal es encontrar la solución más eficiente al cubo, utilizando la menor cantidad de movimientos posible. Los participantes pondrán a prueba su capacidad para visualizar patrones, aplicar algoritmos y tomar decisiones rápidas en busca de la solución óptima. ¡Que comience la competencia! **English** In the Titan FMC 2023, the main objective is to find the most efficient solution to the cube, using the fewest possible number of moves. Participants will put their ability to visualize patterns, apply algorithms, and make quick decisions to the test in pursuit of the optimal solution. Let the competition begin!

items.name: Voula Summer Open 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbUUvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--25a11a161841639a3cff2ecfb046c27deb82697e/Cubestore_VSO23_post.jpg) Το Voula Summer Open 2023 είναι ο 3oς WCA διαγωνισμός στην Ελλάδα για το 2023. Είμαστε περήφανοι για την πορεία μας φέτος και συνεχίζουμε δυναμικά. Στη σειρά διαγωνισμών "Road to Greek Nationals" εστιάζουμε σε κάθε διαγωνισμό σε 2 events που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστά στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε στο ελληνικό κοινό τα αγωνίσματα του One Handed/Λύση με ένα χέρι και του Fewest Move Challenge (FMC)/Δοκιμασία λύσης με τις λιγότερες κινήσεις πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος μας είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο εθνικό πρωτάθλημα της Ελλάδας προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλα τα WCA events θα είναι οικεία στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) The Voula Open 2023 is the third competition this year in Greece. We are proud of our progress and we strongly continue our effort. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come to the cubing celebration! During each "Road to Greek finals" competition, we focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we are aiming to bring the events One Handed and Fewest Move Challenge (FMC) closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all WCA events will be familiar to the competitors. Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.
